Commentary.Commentary: Indians, will like to go about for this chase in a positive manner and maybe finish it off in 15 overs. Can West Indies show their mettle of why they are World Champions? Do join us for the chase in a bit.

Amit Mishra took Johnson's wicket off his first ball and proved his selection right as he ended his figures for 4-0-24-3. All the bowlers did well to take wickets and be economical barring Bhuvi and Shami who were a little expensive and Jadeja being wicket less in his 2-over spell. Overall it was a superb bowling performance with Bumrah being exceptional in death overs.

What a roaring comeback from Indians after yesterday's run-fest! Indians have certainly done a superb job today to bowl out West Indies at a paltry total of 143. The Men in Blue looked a different side altoghter here as they bowled great lines and lengths to each and specific batsmen. Mohammed Shami did well to take the prized wicket of Evin Lewis but Johnson Charles continued his blazing form.
OUT! Thats it! Full ball on the stumps, Badree goes for a big shot but is undone. The ball disturbs the woodwork and with the Windies are bowled out at 143! Terrific turnaround from Indians.
Yorker on middle and leg, played to the on side for a single.
SIX! Massive! Back of a length ball outside off, Narine clears his front foot and slams it just over long on fielder for a biggie. Good connection from the southpaw.
A perfect length ball outside off, Narine tries to run that away but is beaten.
Mohammed Shami to bowl the last over.
Dark clouds have started hovering over the stadium.
Hurls a length ball outside off, Badree tries to play at it but is beaten.
Fuller again and it is lofted over covers for a single.
Full ball on off, pushed to covers for a single.
On the pads, played to the leg side for a single.
Length ball on off, a play and a miss.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh-pad.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl again.
Serves it on the pads, it hits him high on the thigh-pads. End of an over
Samuel Badree is the last man in.
OUT! Amit Mishra has the last laugh! Googly ball on the stumps, Brathwaite goes for a wild slog but misses the line completely. The ball hits the woodwork and the captain has to go. 9 down, Windies.
Serves it on off, it goes of an inside edge to the keeper on the bounce.
Tossed up ball on off, played to point.
SIX! Into the orbit! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Brathwaite clears his front foot and dispatches it into the  mid-wicket stand for a big, big maximum.
FOUR! Reverse swept! Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Carlos reverse sweeps it through backward point for a boundary.
Sunil Narine is in.

OUT! Russell departs! Full ball outside off, Russell looks to set free as he lofts it. The ball goes straight to the man at long off where Kohli takes it easily. Andre Russell has holed out and Windies are 8 down now. What a bowling display from the Men in Blue.
Length ball on off, the skipper looks to hoick that but it goes of an inside edge via pads to the off side. Single taken.
What shot was that! Full ball outside off, Brathwaite comes across and awkwardly plays it to the leg side for a brace.
Wide! Hurls a full ball wide outside off, infact too wide outside off. The umpire signals it as a wide.
FOUR! Cheeky! Low full toss outside off, Carlos kneels down and scoops it through short fine leg for a boundary.
The batsman has edged that one. They pick up a single.
Length ball wide outside off, a play and a miss.
Wide! Too full and wide outside off, out of reach there and the umpire signals it as a wide.
Bhuvaneshwar Kumar is back on.
Quicker ball on the pads, Brathwaite looks to play it on the leg side but is beaten. The ball hits him on the pads.
Loopy ball on middle and leg, tucked to mid-wicket for a single.
Leg-spinning ball on off, defended watchfully.
Floats it on middle and leg, played to the leg side for a single.
Carlos Brathwaite is the new man.

OUT! Amit, you beauty! Googly ball around off, it comes in as Bravo was playing for the leg spin by coming down the track. The ball goes in between bat and pads and crashes into the stumps. The champion, Dwayne Bravo is out of here. India, sterling in Florida with the ball.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Russell slog sweeps it to the leg side for a single.
Amit Mishra back on.
Bravo be careful! Full toss, hit hard straight down the ground. bravo does well to get out of it's way. The ball goes to the long on fileder for a single.
Yorker on midle and leg, Russell does well to get a bat on it. Good comeback by Bumrah!
SIX! Into the crowd! This time Russell gets hold of the short delivery, gets on the top of the bounce and pulls it through square leg for a biggie.
Nice variation! Bangs it in short outside off, angling into the batsman, Russell does well to evade it.
Full around middle and leg, driven to long on for a single.
Full angling into the pads, driven to mid off.
Flighted ball on off, driven to covers for a single.
Short ball on off, cut to point.
On middle and leg, swept to the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball on off, defended neatly.
On the pads, whipped to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, punched to the off side for a single.
Dwayne Bravo replaces Fletcher.
OUT! Bowled 'em! Yorker on the off stump, Fletcher tries to play a big shot but is beaten all hands down. Bumrah gets his man and Windies are 6 down now. Great bowling display from Indians today.
The batsman plays the pull-shot. One run added to the total.
Back of a length ball on off, Fletcher plays a pull shot to the leg side for a single.
Hurls a length ball outside off, a play and a miss.

FOUR LEG BYES! Hurls a bouncer on middle and off, Fletcher ducks in and the ball goes off his helmet to fine leg for a boundary. It is given as a leg bye because of the evasive action taken by Fletcher.
Short ball outside off, slammed to point for no runs.
Full ball on off, defended neatly.
Andre Russell is the new man.

OUT! Ashwin strikes again! Serves a carrom ball around off, it skids after pitching. Pollard goes back in his crease to whip it off to the on side but misses the line of the ball. It goes on to hit the pads. The lbw appeal is on and the umpire raises his dreaded finger. The dangerman departs after that short attacking role.
Flighted ball on the pads, Fletcher plays it to the leg side off his back foot for a single.
Floats it up on middle and off, Fletcher tries to play at it but is beaten.
Bowls it on the pads, Pollard chips it to the leg side for a single.
Serves it on the pads, tucked to the leg side for a single.
SIX! Clobbered! Short ball on middle and off, Pollard hoicks that over mid-wicket for a rocketing biggie. Pure powerhouse.
That was a close shave! Angles in a full ball, Pollard tries to whip it off the on side but misses. The lbw appeal is turned down.
FOUR! Utilized! A low full toss on off, pollard lofts it over the bowler's head for a welcome boundary.
Free Hit coming up!
No ball! Length ball on off, Pollard blocks it but is given as a no ball for overstepping.
Serves it on the pads, flicked to the leg side for a brace.
Ful lball on off, defended neatly.
Keiron Pollard to bat next.
OUT! Bumrah strikes! Length ball on middle and off, Samuels off his back foot tries to make some room on that but is cramped for room and the ball goes off a nick to the keeper. Another wicket down.
Jasprit Bumrah to bowl next.
Full ball on off, a play and a miss.
India picking wickets at regular intervals.
Andre Faletcher is the new man in.

OUT! What a piece of bowling! Ashwin from around the wicket sees Simmons coming down the track and bowls it wide down the leg side. Lendl was way outside the crease and tried to block it with his pads but failed. Dhoni does a regulation of a stumping. Wickets are falling like house of cards now. It is given as a wide.
Tossed up ball outside off, defended neatly.
Loopy ball on the pads, worked to the leg side for a single.
Serves it on middle and leg, flicked to mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls it on the pads, worked to the leg side for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle and leg, Samuels shimmies down to the pitch and blocks it.
Ravichandran Ashwin to bowl now.
Short ball outside off, cut to point for a single.
Quicker ball on off, a play and a miss.
Darts it outside off, cut to point.
Serves it on off, pushed through point for a single.
FOUR! Classic! Pitches it short outside off, Simmons gets back quickly and crashes it through cover-point for another boundary.
FOUR! Cut away! Short ball outside off, Simmons sets back and cuts it through point for a racy boundary.
Serves it on off, driven to covers for a single.
Close call! Tossed up ball around off, Simmons tries to block it but misses it. The appeals for lbw are out but the umpire turns it down. Impact outside off maybe.
FOUR! Lofted! Loopy ball outside off, Simmons lofts it over covers for a boundary. Great technique there.
Googly ball on off, defended neatly.
On the pads, played to the leg side for a single.
The run-rate have dipped down massivel. Surely, Simmons and Samuels should get a move on as they have a deep batting line-up.

Tossed up ball outside off, Simmons pushes it to covers and sets off for a quick single. The throw is fired at the striker's end and Dhoni deflects it onto the stumps. The replays show that Samuels was well in.
On the pads, tucked to the leg side for a single.
Bowls it outside off, played to covers.
Tossed up ball on off, steered to third man.
Floats it on off, Simmons plays it to point.
Bowls it quick outside off, a play and a miss.
Darts on middle and off, Simmons cuts it to point.
Ravindra Jadeja to bowl now.
Loopy ball outside off, Simmons pushes it to covers for a single. Good over that from Mishra.
Bowls it outside off, steered to third man for a run.
Wide! Serves it on middle and it turns away to the leg side. A wide is signaled.
Flighted ball outside off, Samuels off his front foot defends it.
Serves it on the pads, Simmons flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Floats it on off, defended neatly.
Lendl Simmons to bat next.

OUT! Amit Mishra, gets a wicket too! He is all over the place as I said! Tossed up ball on middle and off, Charles clears his front foot to play a big shot. He connects it but cannot clear the fence. Ajinkya Rahane takes it with glee after covering a good distance towards his left. Windies have lost both their destructive openers. India is setting a good comeback.
Amit Mishra to bowl now.
Full away from the off stump, Charles looks to cover drive it but gets an inside edge to square leg for a single.
Pitched wide outside off, driven to mid off.
FOUR! Straight down the ground! Again a full delivery outside off, this time Charles drives it firmly straight down the ground for another boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Full outside off, JC walks across and lofts it one bounce into the crowd through the mid-wicket region.
Again a full delivery wide outside off, Charles again gtes down on his knee but this time manages to loft it over covers for a brace.
Full and wide outside off, Charles kneels down looking to drive through covers but mistimes it back to the bowler.
Hurls a full ball on the pads, worked to the leg side for a single. 15 runs over here.
FOUR! Swiped! Length ball outside off, Charles sees it early and swipes it from outside off to the leg side for another boundary.
FOUR! Edged and runs! Back of a length ball on middle and off, Johnson tries to pull that away but it goes of a top edge over the keeper's head for a rocketing boundary.
SIX! Charles continues his strokeplay! Short ball on middle and leg, Johnson pulls that over backward square leg for a biggie.
Marlon Samuels is the new man in.

OUT! Shami draws first blood! Back of a length ball on middle and leg, Lewis goes back in his crease and looks to pull that but the ball lobs towards short fine leg off his gloves. Amit Mishra who has been a livewire so far in the field, takes an easy catch to send bag-packing Lewis. No century show from him today.
Length ball on off, driven to mid off.
Ends by bowling yet another full ball outside off, Charles tries to crash it but he fails to do so. Good comeback from Bhuvi.
A low full toss wide outside off, Johnson looks to drive that but fails to connect.
Full ball wide outside off, Charles goes for it anyway. The ball catches an inside edge and Dhoni fails to collect it. The batsmen run for a brace of that misfield.
Wide yorker outside off, Johnson looks to steer that but sees it thud into the gloves of Dhoni.
SIX! Punished! Serves a length ball on off, not much pace on it. Charles clears his front foot and deposits it into the mid-wicket stand. The fielder out there is a mere spectator.
Perfect length ball outside off, angling in after pitching. Charles goes for a hoick but misses it.
FOUR! Easily done! Hurls that short of a length on the leg side, Lewis off his back foot runs that fine through long leg for a racy boundary.
Short ball outside off, Charles pulls it awkwardly towards mid on for a single.
Amit Mishra is all over the place! Length ball outside off, Charles steers it fine towards third man and Amit dives and saves a boundary. Brace taken.
Back of a length ball on middle an leg, Lewis off his back foot glances it to short fine leg. Amit Mishra does well to stop that ball. Single taken.
Bouncer on middle and off, Charles rides the bounce to deep mid-wicket only for a single. Good field-setting here by India today.
Hurls a length ball on the sixth stump line, Charles sets on his back foot and plays it to covers. No runs there.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end.
Full ball on off, blocked neatly.
Superb running! Full ball on the pads, the centurion from yesterday's game flicks to the on side for a brace.
Back of a length ball on off, Johnson tamely pushes it to mid on for a single. Good batting that.
FOUR! Short ball on middle and off, Charles waits for it on his back foot and pulls it over backward square leg for a boundary. Off the mark Windies.
Length ball on off, Charles likes the width as he crashes it to mid on. Amit Mishra does well to stop that.
Starts off with a length ball outside off, Charles sets back and cuts it to the off side.

It's nice weather to play under with clear blue skies at the moment. Indian team is in a huddle. Johnson Charles and Evin Lewis are the two West Indies opener. Bhuvneshwar Kumar will bowl first up. Here we go...
Delay continues as the match will start at 2010 IST now.
The news from the center is that the match will begin at 2000 IST.
BCCI has just tweeted that the start of the match has been delayed because of technical reasons.
Team changes - West Indies are unchanged. For India Stuart Binny makes way for Amit Mishra.
TOSS - MS Dhoni spins the coin and Carlos Brathwaite calls it wrong. India will bowl first.

India, on the other hand, will like to make amends by winning today's game. The star player Virat Kohli will be the key yet again and all eyes will be set on him. Rohit Sharma and KL Rahul too will like to continue from where they left yesterday. MS Dhoni will surely like to redo that last ball finish  in India's favor today. So, here we are in Florida where a hurricane alert is being issued and we hope it clears out soon. Stay with us as toss and other updates coming up really soon.

Hello and warm welcome everyone for this 2nd T20I between India and West Indies. What a game we had yesterday where almost 500 runs were scored and stands were deposited with sixes and fours. The batsmen were in absolute delight seeing the pitch. Two hundreds were scored, one from each team. But who would have expected that the Windies after posting a mammoth score will win only by a whisker. Dwayne Bravo is the man to give credit for bowling that final over where he had to defend mere 8 runs.
